retrieved_sources.title: ConfigurePipeline Java Microservices Skill
retrieved_sources.text:
The skill supports Java microservices only (Build phase). 

It creates or validates:

* `.pipeline_dep.yml` at the repository root when the source repository contains more than one microservice
* `.pipeline_pipeline.yml` per microservice
* `scqs_scan_jenkins.properties` per microservice
* `pipeline-container-config.yml` per microservice

Install the Skill
-----------------

### Prerequisites

Access : 

* Access to the [ReleaseEngineering skills repository](https://git.example.com/reference/resource-220).
* PipelineHub project onboarding access is required later if you intend to create or update the PipelineHub project after generating the files.

Tooling : 

* Codex desktop application or Codex CLI.
* Git.
* Python 3  (Python 3 runs the bundled Pipelineization generator. It scans the Java source repository and its Helm configuration, then creates the required Pipeline-related CI/CD files and configuration for each microservice. Python is not a dependency of the Java application itself.

retrieved_sources.title: Family Environment - User Guide
retrieved_sources.text:
1. Click on the "Release Set" from the drop down list
	2. Enter the text you wish to enter in the field for the "**Purpose**"
	3. On selection, it will load the remaining page with the pre-populated value(s) like Template Type and Template Size and other information.
		* Reminder: PipelineHub currently does not validate the authenticity of the selected MOAB.
		* Reminder: You have to **make sure** you select the **right Template Size + Template Type combinations** correspond to the templates associated to the selected MOAB.
3. Select "Config Languages"
	* Reminder: PipelineHub currently does not validate the authenticity of the selected MOAB.
	* Reminder: You have to **make sure** you have selected the **right languages** correspond to the templates associated to the selected MOAB.
	* You can select 1 or a max of 2 languages. If you leave it blank, KO (KO stands for Korean) will be defaulted as the selected language to be provisioned.
	* Alternatively, you can just enter "Pseudo KO"
4. Click on "**CloudNative V2**" or "**CloudNative V3**"  
  
             
  - On selecting the **CloudNative V2** we can see the "CloudNative Services" and below this you can select either "**All**" or "**Selected**"   
  - Also you can search with Org/Service Name/Version and it will be displayed accordingly under the "**Services from Selected ApplicationBOM**". Also you can select the services under the Selected Services.

retrieved_sources.title: ConfigurePipeline Java Microservices Skill
retrieved_sources.text:
For a repository containing two or more microservices (monorepo), verify the root dependency file:

test -f .pipeline_dep.yml \
 && echo ".pipeline_dep.yml found" \
 || echo ".pipeline_dep.yml is required only for multi-microservice repositories"Inspect it:

cat .pipeline_dep.ymlExpected shape:

components:
 - name: orders
 source: msvc/orders
 - name: payments
 source: msvc/paymentsVerify that:

* There is one entry for every microservice.
* Each `name` is simple and unique.
* Each `source` is relative to the source repository root.
* The name uses Helm `[microservice.name](https://app.example.com/reference/resource-221)` when it exists.
* No AppPackage components or AppPackage Pipeline files were generated.
